title.narrative: Water Supply and Sanitation Sector Project

description.narrative:
The project will improve the performance of provincial water utilitiess and expand access to safe piped water supply and sanitaton for urban residents in small towns in the Lao PDR. The project will contribute to the government's urban sector targets - 90% coverage for piped water supply and 100% coverage for sanitation by 2030 by improving sector coordination and policy implementation in corporatization, improving nonrevenue water management and expanding water supply in povincial towns, developing new water supply systems in small towns, enhancing community action in urban water supply and sanitation and strengthening capacity for project implementation and operation and maintenance.
The project impact will be expanded access to quality and reliable piped water supply and sanitation services for the urban population in the Lao PDR. The outcome will be improved performance of participating water utilities in delivering sustainable water supply and sanitation services.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Developed new water supply systems in small towns Indicator: 150 kilometers of water supply distribution pipelines installed (2013 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Achieved: 151.990 km of water supply distribution pipelines were installed (Long, Pha Oudom, Botene, Pakkading, Dakcheung, Sopbao, Namthouam and Viengkham subprojects). Data Source: same as above Actual value:

Output: Developed new water supply systems in small towns Indicator: At least nine new systems constructed (2013 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Ongoing: new water supply system was constructed for 8 out of 9 subprojects (Long, Pha Oudom, Botene, Pakkading, Dakcheung, Sopbao, Viengkham and Namthouam), pending Sanamxay. Data Source: PNP corporate plans; WSRC annual performance reports; Project progress and annual project performance monitoring and evaluation reports. Actual value:

Output: Enhanced community action in urban water supply and sanitation Indicator: 100% of improved public toilet facilities (separate male and female) conducive to proper menstrual hygiene Progress/Status: Ongoing: Total 187 out of 205 public toilets are constructed with separate cubicles and separate entrances for males/females. Data Source: Project progress and project completion reports; Community participation plans; Village proposals and agreements for VEI; Construction records. Actual value:

Output: Enhanced community action in urban water supply and sanitation Indicator: At least 30% of VDC members assigned to manage VEIs are women Progress/Status: Achieved: total of 1,158 VDC members of which 422 members are female (approximately 36%). Data Source: Project progress and project completion reports; Community participation plans; Village proposals and agreements for VEI; Construction records. Actual value:

Output: Enhanced community action in urban water supply and sanitation Indicator: Each participating district town approved a sanitation regulation and confirms that HHs with improved sanitation systems receive piped water supply connections Progress/Status: Achieved: Sanitation regulations have been developed as part of contract award compliance and signed by each (15 subprojects) district governor.
Data Source: Project progress and project completion reports; Community participation plans; Village proposals and agreements for VEI; Construction records. Actual value:

Output: Improved nonrevenue water management and water supply development Indicator: 250 kilometers of water supply distribution pipelines installed (2013 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Achieved. 321.585 km of water supply distribution pipelines are installed in 6 subprojects (New Namtha, Pakxan, Xayabury, Xamneua and Samakkhixay). Data Source: PNP corporate plans; WSRC annual performance reports; Project progress reports; Annual project performance monitoring and evaluation reports. Actual value:

Output: Improved nonrevenue water management and water supply development Indicator: At least six systems expanded in provincial capitals (2013 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Ongoing. 5 subprojects completed (New Namtha, Pakxan, Xayabury, Xamneua and Namthouam), pending 1 subproject (Sanamxay) which is under construction (94% completed). Data Source: PNP corporate plans; WSRC annual performance reports; Project progress reports; Annual project performance monitoring and evaluation reports.
Actual value:

Output: Improved nonrevenue water management and water supply development Indicator: NRW programs completed in at least six participating PNPs (2013 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Achieved: The NRW program was developed for 6 PNPs including provision of training. Data Source: PNP corporate plans; WSRC annual performance reports; Project progress reports; Annual project performance monitoring and evaluation reports. Actual value:

Output: Improved sector coordination and policy implementation Indicator: At least 30% of female staff from participating PNPs, participate in management training related to corporate plan implementation Progress/Status: Achieved. - Corporate Plan preparation Training was conduct for 38 PNPs staff (16 female, 42.11%) participated by PNP of Luang Namtha, Bokeo, Xayaburi, Borikhamxay, Houaphanh, Luang Prabang, Sekong and Attapeu.
- Online PNP CP workshop to discuss Tariff Guideline and Corporate Plan guideline. Total 96 PNP staff participated (33 female, 34%).
- On the Job training to discuss CP content in details, participated by total 36 staff from PNPs and PCU (13 female, 36.11%).
Data Source: Project progress and annual PPME reports Actual value:

Output: Improved sector coordination and policy implementation Indicator: At least five joint subsector reviews held
At least three hygiene promotion events held about WASH and gender held in conjunction with the Provincial Department of Health (2013 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Achieved. 5 meetings were conducted by Department of Water Supply - To finalize requirements of water supply standard, Vientiane Province. - Strategy of water supply and Sanitation Development plan for 2021 - 2030.
Achieved. 4 hygiene promotion events relate to WASH and gender were conducted in collaboration with Provincial Health Department in Houaphan, Sekong, Attapeu, and Luang Namtha Province. - 2 Project Steering Committee Meetings to review implementation status and way forward. - To finalize the guideline for PNP corporate plan and tariff guideline, January 2023
Data Source: Project progress and annual PPME reports Actual value:

Output: Improved sector coordination and policy implementation Indicator: O&M manuals prepared and implemented for each project support system by participating PNPs. An asset register prepared by participating PNPs (2013 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Ongoing. The O&M plans were prepared together with trainings for 11 out of 15 subprojects. 4 subprojects will be completed during extension period.
Achieved. The asset register is developed and implemented by all 8 PNPs.
Data Source: Project progress and annual PPME reports Actual value:

Output: Improved sector coordination and policy implementation Indicator: One service agreement signed for each new or expanded system Progress/Status: Achieved: 8 service agreements signed for 8 PNPs (Luang Namtha, Bokeo, Xayabury, Borikhamxay, Houaphanh, Sekong, Attapeu and Luang Prabang). Data Source: Project progress and annual PPME reports Actual value:

Output: Strengthened capacity for project implementation and O&M Indicator: 100% of female staff from participating PNPs receiving training at least one on the job training in a job-related training Progress/Status: Achieved. All 226 female staff from 8 participating PNPs receiving trainings related to their job. Data Source: Project progress and completion reports; community participation plans; Village proposals and agreements for VEI; and Construction records. Actual value:

Output: Strengthened capacity for project implementation and O&M Indicator: An O&M plan is prepared for each VEI Progress/Status: Ongoing. O&M plan were completed for 11 out of 15 VEIs. Pending 4 VEIs. Data Source: Project progress and completion reports; community participation plans; Village proposals and agreements for VEI; and Construction records. Actual value:

Output: Strengthened capacity for project implementation and O&M Indicator: At least 30% of project training opportunities, professional exchanges, and peer study tours and study trips for qualified women Progress/Status: Achieved: 169 (32.31%) qualified women participants out of total 523 participants were women. Data Source: Project progress and completion reports; community participation plans; Village proposals and agreements for VEI; and Construction records. Actual value:

Output: Strengthened capacity for project implementation and O&M Indicator: At least 30% of staff on project coordination and implementation units being female Progress/Status: Achieved: 40% of female staff working under PCU and 37% under PIU are female.
Data Source: Project progress and completion reports; community participation plans; Village proposals and agreements for VEI; and Construction records. Actual value:

Output: Improved sector coordination and policy implementation Indicator: Participating PNPs updated their corporate plans annually and including sex-disaggregated information Progress/Status: Achieved: 8 PNP corporate plans have been developed and annually updated with sex-disaggregated information. Data Source: Project progress and annual PPME reports Actual value:

Output: Enhanced community action in urban water supply and sanitation Indicator: At least 3,000 meters of roads with drainage improved in project villages. Progress/Status: Achieved: Total of 13,709.74 m of roads with drainage were constructed to support project villages. Data Source: Project progress and project completion reports; Community participation plans; Village proposals and agreements for VEI; Construction records. Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2026 Target value: 3000 meters
Performance of participating provincial nam papas (provincial water utilities) in delivering sustainable water supply and sanitation services increased.

By 2026: e. At least three of eight participating PNPs able to access other external financing as a result of improved creditworthiness Progress/Status: Achieved. Luang Namtha, Luang Prabang and Xayaboury PNPs managed to access to external financing sources. Data Source: Annual reports by MPWT, monitoring reports, ADB loan missions, project completion reports Actual value:

By 2026: a. About 200,000 urban residents in about 15 towns with access to reliable piped water supply meeting appropriate drinking water quality standards (2013 baseline: 100,000 residents) Progress/Status: Ongoing. About 198,000 residents in 11 completed subprojects receive access to reliable piped water supply (equivalent to approximately 36,000 household connections). Data Source: Annual reports by MPWT, monitoring reports, ADB loan missions, project completion reports Actual value:

By 2026: d. All participating PNPs achieved full cost recovery and maintained arrears at less than 90 days (2013 baseline: one of six PNPs) Progress/Status: Ongoing. The progress of 8 PNPs manage to cover 100% of O&M costs is being monitored. The Corporate Plans and Water Tariffs are in process of updating and approval by relevant provincial authorities. Data Source: Annual reports by MPWT, monitoring reports, ADB loan missions, project completion reports Actual value:

By 2026: b. About 210,000 urban residents in about 15 towns with access to improved sanitation facilities (2013 baseline: 170,000 residents) Progress/Status: Ongoing. About 197,800 residents have access to improved sanitation. 647 sanitation grants to improve private latrines provided to poor households of which 250 are headed by a female. 193 new public latrines constructed. Data Source: Annual reports by MPWT, monitoring reports, ADB loan missions, project completion reports Actual value:
